notes: Pipeline evals for the deployed generation after human activation. The fixture has one non-merge commit, so the unscoped case deterministically exercises the scattered/no-concentration widen path. These evals are authored now but are not run before activation.

evals.name: scan-only-renders-a-temporary-report
evals.prompt:
/improve-codebase-architecture

Run an explicitly unscoped architecture scan. Do not select or implement a candidate. The fixture history has no meaningful hotspot, so widen the scan as the skill directs. Render the report, attempt to open it, and finish by printing its absolute path. Discovery must remain read-only and no worktree may be created.
evals.expected_output: The unscoped run discloses that the history yielded no meaningful concentration and widened the scan, then prints an absolute temporary architecture-review HTML path. The file truthfully contains either evidence-backed before/after candidates and a top recommendation or an explicit no-candidate result. The repository, HEAD, local branches, and linked worktrees remain unchanged.

asserts.name: temporary report exists outside repository
asserts.shell: report=$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -Eo '/[^[:space:]]*/architecture-review-[^[:space:]]*\.html' | tail -1); test -n "$report" || fail "no architecture-review- path in output"; [ -f "$report" ] || fail "report does not exist: $report"; case "$report" in "$REPO"/*) fail "report was written inside repository";; esac

asserts.name: report is evidence-backed or truthful
repository and branches stayed unchanged
asserts.shell: test "$WT_COUNT" -eq 0 || fail "created $WT_COUNT linked worktree(s)"; status=$(git -C "$REPO" status --porcelain); test -z "$status" || fail "repository changed: $status"; test "$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse origin/main)" || fail "HEAD moved"; branches=$(git -C "$REPO" for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/heads); test "$branches" = "main" || fail "local branches changed: $branches"

evals.name: clear-selection-reaches-a-design-worktree
evals.prompt:
/improve-codebase-architecture tinytask.store

The selected candidate is concrete: deepen `tinytask.store`. Nobody is present to answer routine questions. Answer only reversible in-scope recommendations yourself. If a question is scope-redrawing, hard to reverse, involves a credential or spending, or you cannot answer it from the repository, stop. Establish an isolated worktree, complete and commit the design, reach the approved `grill-with-docs` review, then recommend `writing-plans` or `to-issues` and stop. Do not create a plan. Do not refactor or change anything under `tinytask/` or `tests/`.
evals.expected_output: One isolated worktree contains a committed design spec for the concrete tinytask.store selection. The design reaches grill-with-docs, source and tests remain unchanged, no plan exists, and the final response recommends writing-plans or to-issues while explicitly stopping before either workflow or implementation.

asserts.name: one isolated design worktree exists
asserts.shell: test "$WT_COUNT" -eq 1 || fail "expected one worktree, got $WT_COUNT"; test -n "$WT" || fail "worktree path missing"

asserts.name: source and tests stayed unchanged
asserts.shell: path_unchanged_since "$REPO" origin/main tinytask tests; path_unchanged_since "$WT" origin/main tinytask tests

asserts.name: no plan was created
asserts.shell: if has_file "$REPO/$PLAN_DIR"/*.md "$WT/$PLAN_DIR"/*.md; then fail "plan created before the scope gate"; fi

asserts.name: scope workflow was recommended and execution stopped

evals.name: foggy-selection-routes-to-wayfind
evals.prompt:
/improve-codebase-architecture sync between machines

Explore the selected direction `sync between machines`. It is deliberately foggy: route it to `wayfind`, create exactly one new map, then stop and return control. Do not create a worktree, spec, plan, or issue. Do not continue into `to-issues`, `writing-plans`, implementation, or execution, and do not change `tinytask/` or `tests/`. Make your final non-empty output line exactly: `WAYFIND_COMPLETE: map created; control returned before issue creation, planning, or implementation.`
evals.expected_output: The fog gate invokes wayfind and creates exactly one new map while preserving the existing concurrent-shells map. It stops with the exact final status `WAYFIND_COMPLETE: map created; control returned before issue creation, planning, or implementation.` There is no worktree, spec, plan, source/test mutation, issue creation, planning, implementation, or execution.

asserts.name: new wayfind map exists and prior map stayed unchanged
asserts.shell: new_map_count=0; new_map=; for map in "$REPO"/.claude/wayfind/*/map.md; do case "$map" in */concurrent-shells/map.md) continue;; esac; [ -f "$map" ] || continue; relative_map=${map#"$REPO"/}; if git -C "$REPO" cat-file -e "origin/main:$relative_map" 2>/dev/null; then continue; fi; new_map_count=$((new_map_count + 1)); new_map=$map; done; test "$new_map_count" -eq 1 || fail "expected exactly one new wayfind map, found $new_map_count"; test -n "$new_map" || fail "new wayfind map path missing"; path_unchanged_since "$REPO" origin/main .claude/wayfind/concurrent-shells

asserts.name: no spec or plan was created
asserts.shell: if has_file "$REPO/$SPEC_DIR"/*.md "$REPO/$PLAN_DIR"/*.md; then fail "created a spec or plan after fog routing"; fi

asserts.name: wayfind returned control without continuation
asserts.shell: terminal_line=$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | sed '/^[[:space:]]*$/d' | tail -n 1); test "$terminal_line" = 'WAYFIND_COMPLETE: map created; control returned before issue creation, planning, or implementation.' || fail "missing exact terminal wayfind status"
